metadata.title: chore: Allowlist dependency-review pylint-pedantic and bump dependencies (Dependabot)
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Configure dependency-review workflow to allow-list 'pylint-pedantic' despite GPL licensing (plugin is used ONLY as a plugin to the pyling command-line tool; no code is altered)
- Update `filelock` to 3.20.3, `pre-commit` to 4.5.1, `tox` to 4.34.1, and `tox-uv` to 1.29.0 to address Dependabot findings

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR configures the dependency-review workflow to focus on runtime vulnerabilities and updates several development dependencies to their latest versions. **Changes:** - Configure dependency-review to only fail on runtime scope vulnerabilities - Bump `filelock` from 3.20.2 to 3.20.3 - Bump `pre-commit` from 4.3.0 to 4.5.1, `tox` from 4.30.3 to 4.34.1, and `tox-uv` from 1.28.0 to 1.29.0 ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | pyproject.toml | Updates minimum versions for filelock, pre-commit, tox, and tox-uv dependencies | | .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml | Adds fail-on-scope configuration to limit workflow failures to runtime dependencies | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.
